title: craspedia uniflora var. viscosa
intro: Craspedia uniflora var. viscosa, commonly known as Sticky Billy, is a flowering plant native to Australia, belonging to the daisy family. The health benefits of Sticky Billy include its potential to soothe and calm the nervous system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its sedative and anti-inflammatory effects, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as sesquiterpenes and flavonoids. The bioactive constituents of Sticky Billy, including sesquiterpenes and flavonoids, contribute to its medicinal properties and may provide relief from anxiety, insomnia, and other health issues.
